name: LiquidHomeButton
description: Spatial liquid-glass pill button featuring a concentric chromatic dispersion prism ring, orbiting white-hot caustic light arcs, and brushed-silver Home iconography with tactile spring feedback.

checkpoints.name: v1: Initial AI Creation
checkpoints.description: Spatial liquid-glass pill button featuring a concentric chromatic dispersion prism ring, orbiting white-hot caustic light arcs, and brushed-silver Home iconography with tactile spring feedback.

checkpoints.name: v2: Rebuilt chromatic prism ring with 60fps HiDPI Canvas optical renderer matching exact video oscillating caustic sweep, additive RGB dispersion, dynamic right-side surge bloom, and sharp z-layered Home icon
checkpoints.description: Rebuilt chromatic prism ring with 60fps HiDPI Canvas optical renderer matching exact video oscillating caustic sweep, additive RGB dispersion, dynamic right-side surge bloom, and sharp z-layered Home icon

checkpoints.name: v3: Upgraded to v3 GPU WebGL GLSL Fragment Shader with analytic 3D glass torus normals, 7-wavelength Cauchy chromatic dispersion, ACES filmic tone mapping, and premultiplied contour-hugging optical bloom (eliminated muddy radial blobs and canvas stroke aliasing)
checkpoints.description: Upgraded to v3 GPU WebGL GLSL Fragment Shader with analytic 3D glass torus normals, 7-wavelength Cauchy chromatic dispersion, ACES filmic tone mapping, and premultiplied contour-hugging optical bloom (eliminated muddy radial blobs and canvas stroke aliasing)

checkpoints.name: v4: v4: Calibrated WebGL GLSL shader against reference frames — eliminated dotted aliasing, pink/magenta bloom tint, and washed-out ring; added supersampled GPU buffer, sharp obsidian contrast valleys, vivid 7-wavelength jewel dispersion, pure warm-white optical bloom, and crisp 1px glass torus bevel
